description: Four percussive envelope generators, each with a VCA and a channel of a mixer, and a choke on each pair

params.text: Sets the level of that channel in the mix, squared so the bottom of the travel is fine-grained
Sets how long that channel's envelope takes to fall, from 4.5ms to 4 seconds; the attack is fixed at 1.5ms
Silences the second channel of that pair for as long as the first channel's envelope is in its attack

inputs.text: The signal that channel's VCA passes; with nothing patched, the even channel of a pair takes the signal from the odd one
Scales the gain of all four channels and their envelope outputs, 0-10V under a square root, so 10V gives full level; with nothing patched all four run at full level
A rising edge fires that channel's envelope; it reads high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Lengthens that channel's decay, 10V covering half the travel of its decay slider, and is added to it

outputs.text: That channel's signal after its VCA, which takes it out of the mix; the fourth channel's jack carries the mix instead and always includes its own channel
That channel's envelope as a voltage, 0-10V at full strength

inputs.5: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.6: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.7: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.8: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
